human_decisions.evidence: https://selinsgrove.org/；公开市政府页及宾夕法尼亚Snyder County政府名单确认Selinsgrove。 语音位置按当前连续原ASR完整词条作整体绑定；未造时间，未宣称两个模型拼写一致。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: Recently a New York Times article describes the town of Selinsgrove in Pennsylvania.

human_decisions.evidence: https://selinsgrove.org/；公开市政府页及宾夕法尼亚Snyder County政府名单确认Selinsgrove。 语音位置按当前连续原ASR完整词条作整体绑定；未造时间，未宣称两个模型拼写一致。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: The article thus concludes that many portions of the country remain, like Selinsgrove, virtually unchanged on this march towards “diversity.”

human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2010-双模型.json，实际窗口[131, 140]。印本takes与独立Whisper takes一致，Parakeet为take；保留有源正文，并明确残余s尾辨音分歧。映射完整短语真音段，不设takes单字内部时刻。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: It refers to features of communication that takes place without the use of grammar or vocabulary.

human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2010-双模型.json，实际窗口[163, 179]。印本与独立Whisper均meaning in communication，Parakeet为and；保留有源in并记模型分歧。完整短语共享真实ASR词段，非全局at/in等价。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: While they are, perhaps, not central to meaning in communication in the same way as grammar or vocabulary, they may, nevertheless, convey attitude or intention in some way.

human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2010-双模型.json，实际窗口[348, 356]。印本及Whisper为favorite，Parakeet为favored；不按单一模型改源词，按完整短语绑定同一实际语音段并保留辨音差异。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: That is to say different cultures have their own favorite gestures in conveying meaning.

human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2010-双模型.json，实际窗口[909, 925]。原印本homogeneous为国家人群同质化常见规范词形，ASR homogenous为同一词位拼写分歧；保留正确印本，使用原ASR完整词边界。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: Well, at one time the US was called a melting pot, you know, which means that people of many different religions, cultures, and races could shed their traditional cultural identities and blend into one homogeneous nation.

human_decisions.evidence: 核验/正文清理/2010-双模型.json，实际窗口[1104, 1118]。新局部Parakeet和Whisper均明确1990s，主ASR 19th century 90s为机器误解；绑定整个年代短语的实际连续音段，不保留机器错误“世纪”作英文、不拆分推算1990内部时刻。
human_decisions.source_sentence_en: On the contrary, Maine’s Caucasian population was 98% of its total population throughout the 1990s; and by 2025, Maine’s population will still be 97% Caucasian, which means virtually no change in Maine’s racial diversity over the next 20 or so years.
